description: This file defines the UpgradeHistory class, which manages records of upgrade histories within the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for querying, checking versions, and managing upgrade records.

classes.name: UpgradeHistory
classes.description: A class representing upgrade history records, providing methods for querying, validation, and version comparison within the SuiteCRM environment.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the current upgrade history record from the database.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the UpgradeHistory class and disables row level security.

methods.name: getAllOrderBy
methods.description: Retrieves all upgrade history record IDs ordered by a specified column.

methods.name: checkForExisting
methods.description: Checks if an upgrade history record with the same name or ID already exists.

methods.name: determineIfUpgrade
methods.description: Determines if a given record represents an upgrade compared to existing versions.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all upgrade history record IDs ordered by date entered descending.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Builds a related list of records from a given query.

methods.name: findByMd5
methods.description: Finds records matching a specific MD5 checksum.

methods.name: UninstallAvailable
methods.description: Checks if an uninstall is available based on patch list and target patch.

methods.name: foundConflict
methods.description: Checks whether there is a conflict between two backup paths.

methods.name: is_right_version_greater
methods.description: Compares two version arrays to determine if the right side is greater or equal.

methods.name: checkDependencies
methods.description: Verifies if dependencies are installed, returns list of missing dependencies.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves a record by ID, ignoring the deleted filter.

methods.name: getPackageDateString
methods.description: Returns the appropriate date string for timestamp comparison.

methods.name: getPackageTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the timestamp for a given date string.
